notes: One price a year, billed annually. It includes setup, your own page, the launch kit, ongoing promotion, usage reports and support.
Your price follows your exact size: between two rows it falls on a straight line, so a few more people adds only a few dollars. Below 25,000 people the first price applies.
People served means your library's service-area population, your credit union's members, your enrolled students or your employees.
Consortia: one contract for every member, at 30% off each member's annual price.
A 90-day pilot is available; ask us about it.
There are no per-person fees and no accounts to count. Everyone you serve can use DeftBrain; the public site stays free.
